summary: HAV INVEST AS (org. no. 980 376 842) is a private limited company (AS) based in Oslo, in the Brønnøysund registers since 1998-12-31. It is active with no bankruptcy or liquidation registered. Its main activity is NACE 68.110 (Kjøp og salg av egen fast eiendom); it has 0 registered employees. In its 2025 accounts (company level) operating revenue was NOK 121 000 and net income was NOK 80 935. CEO: Harald Vaaland; board chair: Harald Vaaland.
